name: Ticker Wire
tagline: Tells you when your holdings file paperwork or make news, and otherwise stays quiet
description: Give it the tickers you genuinely care about and it keeps track of the public regulatory record and the announcements coming out of those companies. Something reaches you only when a new document or story lands, so silence means nothing moved. It reports events and holds no view on what you should do.
author: CitiZenSleuthX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
